feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to related frontend files.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries for many frontend source files used in build planning.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base theme variables and dark mode CSS settings.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry page loading the React app and favicon.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app component handling routing, theming, and layout.
frontend/src/backup/backupIO.ts: Handles exporting and importing backup files with validation and migration.
frontend/src/backup/backupSchema.ts: Backup schema, validation, and migration ensuring settings defaults are applied.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Circul: Animated circular progress SVG displaying percentage values.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Subjec: Displays subject stats with progress, danger state, and optional premium insights.
Layout wrapper providing page structure with optional header and footer.
frontend/src/components/markToday/MarkTo: Generates a bottom sheet to mark today's classes by loading today's timetable slots and saving attendance events.
frontend/src/components/navigation/Botto: Renders a three‑tab mobile bottom navigation bar with active-state styling and icons.
frontend/src/components/settings/AboutCa: Displays app branding, logo, version, and copyright info in an about card.
frontend/src/components/settings/BackupR: Provides backup export/import controls with file selection, confirmation dialog, and restore handling.
frontend/src/components/settings/Notific: Manages browser notification settings, permission requests, warnings, and a test notification button.
frontend/src/components/settings/TargetP: Lets users set a target attendance percentage using a slider and numeric input.
frontend/src/components/settings/ThemeSe: Allows selecting light/dark/system theme mode and choosing a color variant.
frontend/src/components/subjects/Confirm: Reusable confirmation dialog for destructive actions with customizable text and action label.
frontend/src/components/subjects/Subject: Dropdown menu containing edit, reset, and delete actions for a subject.
Dialog component for creating or editing subjects with name validation and save handling.
frontend/src/components/system/ErrorBoun: React error boundary that catches runtime errors and shows a reload prompt.
frontend/src/components/system/InitialLo: Full‑screen animated splash screen displaying the brand logo during app initialization.
frontend/src/components/system/NonBlocki: Hook‑based component that triggers toast notifications when an error occurs.
frontend/src/domain/attendanceCalculatio: Pure functions for calculating attendance stats, safe bunks, required classes, insights, and streaks.
frontend/src/domain/attendanceReducer.ts: Reducer managing subjects, events, timetable, exchanges, settings, and full state resets.
frontend/src/domain/attendanceTypes.ts: Type definitions for subjects, events, stats, timetable, exchanges, settings, and default app state.
frontend/src/domain/premiumInsights.ts: Utilities producing premium insights like predictions, trend direction, and streak messages.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook creating and refreshing a backend actor tied to the current identity and invalidating queries.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Auth context and provider for managing Internet Identity login, stored identities, and status tracking.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind setup defining light, dark, and midnight theme CSS variables plus global styles and motion/scroll behavior.
frontend/src/lib/branding.ts: Exports app branding constants including logo path, alt text, name, and tagline.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Provides utility helpers for class merging, ID generation, date formatting, weekday lookup, and color selection.
frontend/src/main.tsx: App entry that mounts React root with React Query and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/notifications/localNotifica: Generates formatted notification messages for class marking actions and multi-status updates.
frontend/src/notifications/notifications: Wrapper for the browser Notifications API including permission checks and sending notifications.
frontend/src/pages/HomeDashboardPage.tsx: Dashboard showing overall stats, subject cards, mark-today flow, and optional notifications for class updates.
frontend/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx: Settings interface for theme, targets, notifications, premium features, and backup/restore.
frontend/src/pages/SubjectDetailsPage.ts: Page showing stats, safe-bunk and target calculators, recent activity, and edit/reset/delete actions for a subject.
frontend/src/pages/TimetablePage.tsx: Weekly timetable editor with day/period grid and subject assignment in or out of edit mode.
frontend/src/state/appStore.tsx: Sets up global React Context state with reducer, loads initial state from IndexedDB, and saves updates with debouncing.
frontend/src/state/persistence.ts: Wraps IndexedDB load/save logic with validation and merges loaded settings with defaults.
frontend/src/storage/indexedDbClient.ts: Implements low-level IndexedDB operations to open the DB and save, load, or clear the app state.
frontend/src/theme/themeManager.ts: Applies and initializes theme settings, toggling dark mode and theme variants and listening for system changes.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, animations, shadows, plugins, and dark‑mode class handling.
project_state.json: Defines high‑level project state, requirements, architecture notes, image assets, and existing feature tracking.
